option_a.morphology: Minute, elongate and worm-like (vermiform); body annulated; only 2 pairs of legs present in all life stages; no visible segmentation.

option_b.morphology: Body is globus or oval with dorsal setae; larva with three pairs of legs and nymphs and adults with four pairs of legs; one pair of closely placed stigmata at the base of chelicerae or at the anterior idiosomal shoulders.

option_a.morphology: Peritreme well developed; pedipalp with thumb-claw process; body not with transverse dorsal plates; empodium and claw on pretarsus.

option_b.morphology: Peritreme absent; pedipalp without thumb-claw process; body with transverse dorsal plate; prodorsum of adult females with bothridial setae.

option_a.morphology: Empodium with tenent hairs; female with 3 pairs of anal setae (ps1-3) and male with 5 pairs of genito-anal setae.

option_b.morphology: Empodium (rarely absent) without tenent hairs; female with 1 or 2 pairs of anal setae and male with 3 or 4 pairs of genito-anal setae.

option_a.morphology: Empodium claw-like when present, tarsus 1 with loosely associated setae or with 1 pair of duplex setae; when 2 pairs of duplex setae on tarsus 1 then no pairs on tarsus 2.

option_b.morphology: Empodium claw-like or split distally, tarsus 1 with 2 pairs of duplex setae and tarsus 2 with 1 pair.

option_a.morphology: Opisthosoma with f1 in marginal position or absent.

option_b.morphology: Opisthosoma f1 in normal dorsal position.

option_a.morphology: Prodorsal shield with one to five setae, always with anterior setae present (Paired or unpaired vi or paired ve); Legs with all setae and apicolateral or apicoventral solenidion on tibiae of legs. Opisthosoma with subdorsal setae (c1); Accessory setae often long (h1); Female genital coverflap without ridges.

option_b.morphology: Prodorsal shield without anterior setae (vi & ve); no tibial solenidion; Opisthosoma without subdorsal setae (c1); Accessory setae often small or minute (h1); Female genital coverflap with ridges.

option_a.morphology: Gnathasoma large in comparative to body; cheliceral stylets are comparatively long, suddenly bent downward adjacent to base; pedipalpae antennuate, enfolded long-form oral stylets; empodium divided or entire; female genital coverflap without ridges.

option_b.morphology: Gnathasoma small in comparative to body; cheliceral stylets are comparatively long with straight or slightly curved; pedipalpae terminally truncate; enfolded in short form oral stylets; Accessory setae often minute or absent (h1); female genital coverflap with ridges.

option_a.morphology: Tibiae reduced or completely fused with tarsi; tibiae without setae.

option_b.morphology: Tibiae always distinct from tarsi, tibial setae present.

option_a.morphology: Tarsi with spatulate or shovel shaped projections; legs very short, segments are combined, empodia large with many rays.

option_b.morphology: Tarsi without spatulate or shovel shaped projections; coxae of leg 1 is fused across central line; coxal setae 1b absent; empodia comparatively small.

option_a.morphology: Prodorsal shield small, lack tubercles; scapular setae (sc) small on lateral margins, directed laterally; coxa widely separated; lack of ventral setae d and e; Female genitalia at the base of coxa II; coverflaps lack ridges.

option_b.morphology: Prodorsal shield and opisthosomal setation not as above.

option_a.morphology: Female genital apodeme bent up and shortened and heavy transverse line ventrally; female genital coverflap unique with 2 uneven rank ridges; FG close between coxa II as usual; lack of scapular setae (sc).

option_b.morphology: Female genital apodeme normally extends distant forward and has no heavy transverse marks; Female coverflap with variable ridges; FG not close between coxa II.

option_a.morphology: Vermiform body; annuli subequal dorsoventrally upto half or 2/3 of the opisthosoma; prodorsal shield lack frontal lobe or slight projection over gnathasoma base, if at all present often the frontal lobe it is short, flexible with narrow annuli.

option_b.morphology: Fusiform body; wide prodorsal shield with strong frontal lobe on gnathasomal base; broad and stout annuli on opisthosoma are typical.
